mregular.note: Every vertex lies on exactly r edges, counted by incidence (#|edges_at v|): a loop once, parallel edges separately. Vacuous without vertices; with a vertex the degree is unique and equals mDelta; invariant under incidence-preserving bijections.

mcubic.note: mregular G 3, with no loopless guard: three loops at one vertex qualify.

loopless_cubic.note: loopless G /\ mcubic G: the guarded cubic contract, equal to arc-end cubicity (Cycle mdeg) under the guard.
